title: DelegationContract
description: Authoritative contract schema for formal inter-agent task delegation in AcademicSuite (Phase 22). Enforces 10 mandatory task definition fields and 6 structured worker return fields. Prevents informal, un-audited agent delegation.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the delegated task (e.g. TSK-2026-CH4-001).

worker_agent.description: Target specialist worker agent (e.g. statistics-agent, data-agent, academic-writer).

objective.description: Clear, unambiguous description of what the worker agent must achieve.

inputs.description: Input datasets, previous stage artifacts, or parameter specifications required for execution.

required_artifacts.description: Expected deliverables that must physically exist on disk upon completion.

acceptance_criteria.description: Specific mathematical, statistical, or formatting conditions that must be fulfilled for task acceptance.

constraints.description: Operational, ethical, and architectural boundaries (e.g. zero mental calculation, English-only filenames).

verification_method.description: Auditing mechanism or agent responsible for verifying task deliverables (e.g. statistical-auditor, validation-agent).

deadline.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, timeout threshold, or execution phase deadline.

worker_return.description: Formal return payload submitted by the worker agent upon task completion.

evidence.description: Factual computational parameters, test statistics, effect sizes, and degrees of freedom.

validation.description: Independent validation report summary or verdict.

warnings.description: Operational warnings, data quality flags, or execution anomalies encountered.

limitations.description: Statistical or methodological limitations (e.g. sample size constraints, cross-sectional design).
